candidates.original_title: Engagement and disaffection in the classroom: Part of a larger motivational dynamic
candidates.description: The dynamics of engagement and disaffection in the classroom, including how indicators of engagement (behavioral and emotional engagement and disaffection) relate to each other over time and how facilitators (student self-perceptions and teacher support) predict changes in engagement and disaffection
candidates.citation_sentence: In this investigation, we replicated Skinner et al.'s study of the dynamics of engagement with a more diverse sample of Grades 6 and 7 students from a middle school with a large English learner (primarily Spanish-speaking) student population.
candidates.notes: Mixed results: some aspects of Skinner et al.'s model were supported (emotional engagement predicting behavioral engagement and disaffection; self-perceptions mediating teacher support effects) while others were not (emotional disaffection not predicting behavioral engagement/disaffection; behavioral engagement not predicting emotional engagement). Authors use both 'replicated' and 'some aspects supported whereas others were not,' making the overall classification genuinely ambiguous between success and inconclusive.
